note: Real geostationary satellites for the 'GEO belt' List constellation (constellations.json "members_file"). Written by tools/make_geo_belt.py - edit the table there, not this file. APPROXIMATE: slots are the mid-2020s published / commonly tracked positions rounded to 0.1 deg; the sim is set in 2036, so read this as the GEO belt as populated, not a 2036 manifest. Government satellites' slots are amateur-tracking estimates.

classes.large: high-power comsat / HTS, ~5-7 t, solar wings ~40-48 m tip to tip (SSL-1300, Eurostar Neo, Boeing 702HP, Spacebus 4000C4 class)
classes.medium: mid-size comsat, ~3-4 t, wings ~25-30 m (Star-2, A2100, DFH-4, Express-1000 class)
classes.small: small GEO platform (Astranis MicroGEO, NavIC, Luch-5): drawn with the medium model
classes.weather: three-axis weather satellite (GOES-R, Himawari, MTG, Fengyun-4, Elektro-L, INSAT-3D)
classes.spinner: spin-stabilised weather drum (Meteosat Second Generation, Fengyun-2)
